name: litclaude
description: Claude Code-native workflow plugin with a bounded-authority start-work lifecycle.

motion.title: LIT band motion
motion.description: How the band above the prompt moves: full (during work the LIT pill breathes, a light sweeps the phase and a comet runs the border), subtle (only the breathing) or off.

glyphs.title: LIT band glyphs
glyphs.description: auto uses the icon font when it is installed (litclaude-ai install --icon-font); nerd always; basic works with any font.

band.title: LIT band
band.description: When the LIT card shows above the prompt: always (the whole session, idle included), auto (only while LitClaude work is active or a skill of this request is lit) or off.

notify.title: LIT finish notification
notify.description: off, or finish: a notification through your own notification channel when LIT work completes or a LIT turn longer than three minutes ends. finish+sound also plays a sound once LitClaude ships one; until then it notifies like finish.

club.title: LIT club look
club.description: on: once you typed `lit invite @<github-id>`, the idle card wears the gold club look. off keeps the plain ready card. Nothing is sent anywhere.
